name: k1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean shapes, lots of calm white space. Unbranded, no text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A building site seen from the side with NO vehicles and NO people: on the right half a tall unfinished grey concrete building frame with five open floors made of concrete columns and floor slabs, no walls yet, a little scaffolding on one side, the flat roof slab on top has low wooden formwork edges; on the left a small blue site office container and a stack of steel bars; a flat light brown dirt ground across the whole bottom third of the picture. The upper part of the picture is plain white paper (no sky colour).
